message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of some of the most effective exercises you can do to target all the major muscle groups in your legs—quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves, and even the stabilizing muscles around the knees and hips.

| Exercise | Primary Muscles Worked | Key Tips |
|----------|------------------------|----------|
| **Squat** (body‑weight, barbell, goblet) | Quads, glutes, hamstrings, core | Keep your chest up, knees tracking over toes, and drive through the heels. |
| **Lunge** (forward, reverse, walking, side) | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Step far enough that the back knee almost touches the floor; keep torso upright. |
| **Deadlift** (conventional, sumo, Romanian) | Hamstrings, glutes, lower back, traps | Maintain a neutral spine, pull through the heels, and keep the bar close to the shins. |
| **Leg Press** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Adjust foot placement to emphasize different parts of the quads; avoid locking out the knees. |
| **Calf Raise** (standing, seated, single‑leg) | Calves (gastrocnemius & soleus) | Perform a full range of motion—down to a deep stretch and up to a full contraction. |
| **Bulgarian Split Squat** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Place the rear foot on a bench; keep the front knee aligned with the ankle. |
| **Step‑Up** (onto a bench or box) | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Drive through the heel of the stepping leg; keep the back knee from dropping too low. |
| **Hip Thrust / Glute Bridge** | Glutes, hamstrings, core | Squeeze at the top, avoid hyperextending the lower back. |
| **Hamstring Curl** (lying or seated machine) | Hamstrings | Focus on controlled movement; avoid using momentum. |
| **Wall Sit** | Quads, glutes, core | Hold the position for time; keep knees at a 90° angle. |

### How to Structure a Leg‑Day Routine

1. **Warm‑up** – 5–10 min of light cardio + dynamic stretches (leg swings, hip circles).  
2. **Compound Movements** – Start with the big lifts (squat, deadlift, leg press). These recruit the most muscle mass and burn the most calories.  
3. **Isolation / Accessory Work** – Add lunges, step‑ups, hip thrusts, and calf raises to hit each muscle group from different angles.  
4. **Cool‑down** – Light stretching focusing on quads, hamstrings, calves, and hips.  

### Sample 3‑Set Routine

| Set | Exercise | Reps | Rest |
|-----|----------|------|------|
| 1 | Back Squat | 8–10 | 90 s |
| 2 | Walking Lunge | 12–15 per leg | 60 s |
| 3 | Romanian Deadlift | 10–12 | 90 s |
| 4 | Leg Press | 12–15 | 60 s |
| 5 | Standing Calf Raise | 15–20 | 45 s |
| 6 | Hip Thrust | 12–15 | 60 s |

Feel free to mix and match based on your goals (strength, hypertrophy, endurance) and equipment availability. Happy training!
